title: 第一章 三年入宗师第二章 世上只有大姐好
slug: 武道长生从大离第一纨绔开始

read2（）;“把衣服穿上吧，我好了。”
朦胧空间内，一座玉石莲台上。
女子背对青年，如水薄纱滑下，掩住无暇玉背，和完美腰臀。
顾尘风仍处于发懵状态。
他一穿越过来，就意外坠崖。
醒来就发现自己不干净了。
一名他前世今生见过，最美丽，最有气质的女人，把他强占了。
感谢大自然的馈赠！
顾尘风不是正人君子，从错愕到享受，只用了半秒，并主动配合。
但很快，他就发现，这不是一个级别的较量。
顾尘风开始求饶，但此女却如同吃了“炫迈”，根本停不下来。
如今大战结束。
“唉……”
女子轻叹一声。
“想不到本尊威震天恒界，最终竟会沦落到，与一凡俗之辈苟合。
哼，三皇四圣，你们竟敢算计我，等本尊回归，必血染天恒！”
眸中杀机一敛，女子回头望来。
她容颜如玉，五官精致绝伦，连肌肤仿佛都泛着光晕，恍惚似神女临凡。
“我乃永夜魔尊，冷星夜，你救了我一命，想要什么回报？”

“呃……助人为快乐之本，魔尊大人不必客气。”
被此女目光凝视的一瞬，顾尘风只觉遍体冰寒，血液仿佛都被冻结。
这女人的实力显然很变态，不杀人灭口就好，哪敢索要报酬。
“本尊的功法极为特殊，如今已与你血脉绑定，我伤势还未痊愈，今后会再寻你双修。”
听到‘双修’二字，顾尘风双腿直打哆嗦。
“放心吧，下次双修在三年后，但那时，你至少要有宗师级以上的修为。
不然，你会死的。”
“宗师？”
顾尘风已经融合了这个世界的记忆。
天星大陆，武道为尊。
这里是大陆九州之一，衍州大离王朝。
自己的名字也叫顾尘风。
爷爷是帝国右相，三朝元老，修为非凡。
父亲是镇北大将军，手握重兵，号称帝国战神。
两个姐姐也是一流的武道天才。
唯有他是帝都有名的废物纨绔，十六岁还未成为武者。
武者按修为分为：淬体境，通脉境，源气境，源海境，源丹境，源灵境，源象境！
源象境强者，可称“宗师”，一人可屠万军。
整个大离王朝，只有四位宗师级强者，自己爷爷就是其中之一。
“三年入宗师境？”顾尘风觉得对方疯了。

read2(); "Put on your clothes, I'm ready."
In the hazy space, there is a jade lotus platform.
The woman turned her back to the young man, and the gauze slid down like water, covering her flawless back and perfect waist and hips.
Gu Chenfeng was still in a daze.
As soon as he crossed over, he accidentally fell off a cliff.
When I woke up, I realized that I was not clean.
The most beautiful and elegant woman he had ever seen in this life had taken possession of him.
Thank you for the gift of nature!
Gu Chenfeng was not a gentleman. It only took him half a second to go from shock to enjoyment, and he actively cooperated.
But soon, he discovered that this was not a competition at the same level.
Gu Chenfeng began to beg for mercy, but this woman seemed to have eaten "Xuanmai" and couldn't stop at all.
Now the war is over.
"Alas..."
The woman sighed.
"I never expected that this powerful person in the eternal world would eventually fall into the trap of sleeping with a common man.
Huh, Three Emperors and Four Saints, how dare you plot against me. When I return, the sky will be stained with blood! "
The murderous intent in her eyes narrowed, and the woman looked back.
Her face was like jade, her facial features were exquisite, and even her skin seemed to be glowing with light, as if she were in a trance like a goddess coming to earth.
"I am Yongye Demon Lord, Leng Xingye. You saved my life. What do you want in return?"
"Uh...helping others is the foundation of happiness. Lord Demon Lord, you don't have to be polite."
The moment he was stared at by this woman's gaze, Gu Chenfeng felt cold all over his body, and his blood seemed to be frozen.
This woman's strength is obviously very perverted. As long as she doesn't kill people and silence her, how dare she ask for reward.
"My skill is extremely special. It is now bound to your bloodline. My injury has not healed yet. I will seek you out for double cultivation in the future."
Gu Chenfeng's legs trembled when he heard the word 'double cultivation'.
"Don't worry, the next dual cultivation will be in three years, but by then, you must have at least a master level or above.
Otherwise, you will die. "
"Grandmaster?"
Gu Chenfeng has integrated the memory of this world.
In Tianxing Continent, martial arts is respected.
This is one of the nine states in the mainland, Yanzhou Dali Dynasty.
His name is also Gu Chenfeng.
Grandpa is the Right Chancellor of the Empire, a veteran of three dynasties, and has extraordinary cultivation.
His father is the general of Zhenbei. He holds a large number of troops and is known as the Imperial God of War.
The two sisters are also top-notch martial arts geniuses.
He is the only one who is a famous good-for-nothing in the imperial capital, and he has not yet become a warrior at the age of sixteen.
Warriors are divided according to their cultivation levels: Body Tempering Realm, Pulse Channeling Realm, Origin Qi Realm, Origin Sea Realm, Origin Pill Realm, Origin Spirit Realm, and Origin Image Realm!
Those who are strong in the Source Xiang Realm can be called "grand masters", and one person can slaughter thousands of armies.
There were only four master-level experts in the entire Dali Dynasty, and my grandfather was one of them.
"Three years to become a master?" Gu Chenfeng thought the other party was crazy.
